bosses.name: Lord Roccor
bosses.general: Fire and earth shocks and Ground Tremor stuns. Easy.

bosses.name: High Interrogator Gerstahn
bosses.general: Shadow priest: Shadow Word: Pain, Psychic Scream fears, Mana Burn.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward or Tremor Totem on you.
bosses.healer: Dispel Shadow Word: Pain; stay out of her scream range.

bosses.name: Houndmaster Grebmar
bosses.general: Bloodlust and Demoralizing Shout, with his hounds around.

bosses.name: Gorosh the Dervish
bosses.general: Ring of Law: Whirlwind cuts the melee.
bosses.tank: Hold him; the Ring's adds come with him.

bosses.name: Grizzle
bosses.general: Ring of Law: Thunderclap and Ground Tremor stun.

bosses.name: Eviscerator
bosses.general: Ring of Law: Shadow Bolt Volley, and a shield that stops spells.
bosses.dps: Melee do the work while his spell shield is up.

bosses.name: Hedrum the Creeper
bosses.general: Ring of Law spider: Paralyzing Poison and webs.

bosses.name: Ok'thor the Breaker
bosses.general: Ring of Law caster: Arcane Bolt, Arcane Explosion, Polymorph.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his bolts; melee watch the explosion.

bosses.name: Anub'shiah
bosses.general: Ring of Law: Shadow Bolt, curses and Enveloping Web.

bosses.name: Pyromancer Loregrain
bosses.general: Molten Blast and a Searing Totem.
bosses.dps: Kill the totem, interrupt his blasts.

bosses.name: Lord Incendius
bosses.general: At the Black Anvil: Fire Storm, Fiery Burst, Mighty Blow knocks back, and a curse on everyone.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall for the knockbacks.

bosses.name: Warder Stilgiss
bosses.general: Frost caster with Verek his hound: Frost Nova, Frost Ward. Verek enrages when Stilgiss dies.
bosses.healer: Dispel the nova on the tank.

bosses.name: Fineous Darkvire
bosses.general: Dark Iron paladin: Holy Strike and Holy Light.

bosses.name: Bael'Gar
bosses.general: Giant fire elemental: calls lava spawns that split if left alone.
bosses.tank: Hold him and grab the spawns.
bosses.dps: Kill the spawns quickly, then him.

bosses.name: General Angerforge
bosses.general: Cleave, Flurry and Sunder; at low health he calls Anvilrage reservists and medics.
bosses.tank: Face him away; grab the reinforcements.
bosses.healer: Several on the tank at the end.
bosses.dps: Medics first, then the reservists or Angerforge.

bosses.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
bosses.general: Chain Lightning and Shock; he wakes the golems around his room.
bosses.tank: Clear or grab the golems; hold Argelmach.
bosses.dps: Ranged spread; interrupt his chain lightning.

bosses.name: Hurley Blackbreath
bosses.general: Comes for his stolen ale in the Grim Guzzler: Drunken Rage and fire breath.

bosses.name: Phalanx
bosses.general: Golem guard of the Grim Guzzler: Fireball Volley, Mighty Blow knocks back, Thunderclap.

bosses.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
bosses.general: Goblin with his friends in the Grim Guzzler. Easy.

bosses.name: Plugger Spazzring
bosses.general: The barkeep: attacks if you steal the ale. Easy.

bosses.name: Ambassador Flamelash
bosses.general: Burning Spirits walk from the runes around the room into him and make him stronger.
bosses.healer: Heal more if spirits reach him.
bosses.dps: Kill the spirits before they reach him, then back on him.

bosses.name: Doom'rel
bosses.general: The Seven: talk to Doom'rel and the seven dwarves come one at a time, Doom'rel last.
bosses.tank: Hold each one as it comes; keep them apart.
bosses.healer: A long fight: pace your mana.
bosses.dps: Kill each as it comes; interrupt Vile'rel's heals and Haterel's shadow.

bosses.name: Anger'rel
bosses.general: One of the Seven: a warrior with Sunder and Shield Block.

bosses.name: Magmus
bosses.general: Giant golem at the throne room doors: Fiery Burst and War Stomp; the fire jets along the hall stop once he's dead.
bosses.tank: Hold him away from the jets.

bosses.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
bosses.general: Princess Moira heals him: interrupt or crowd control her (don't kill her if someone needs her alive for a quest). Hand of Thaurissan stuns, Avatar of Flame burns all around him.
bosses.tank: Hold the emperor facing away; heal-interrupts are on the others.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Moira's heals and burn the emperor.

bosses.name: Panzor the Invincible
bosses.general: Rare golem: hits hard.
